JND InfraSteel | EPC, Pipeline Infrastructure & Civil Construction Contractors Gujarat
EPC Pipeline Infrastructure & Civil Construction Contractors — Gujarat, India
JND InfraSteel Private Limited is a leading EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) contractor in India specializing in large-diameter pipeline infrastructure, pump house construction, water supply project execution, civil construction works, and professional stockyard management. With an advanced machinery fleet including high-capacity crawler cranes, pipeline lowering equipment, welding rigs, and hydro-testing systems, JND InfraSteel delivers turnkey infrastructure projects for government water authorities and industrial clients across Gujarat and India.
Our Core Capabilities
Large-diameter MS, DI, HDPE and PVC pipeline laying
Cross-country bulk water transmission mains
Pump house construction — RCC structure, mechanical, electrical
Civil construction: intake wells, junction chambers, valve chambers
Pipeline stockyard development and material management
Steel material trading: ERW pipes, HSAW pipes, plates, sections
Government Water Projects & EPC Execution
JND InfraSteel has successfully executed pipeline infrastructure projects under Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM), AMRUT, and various state water supply authority schemes across Gujarat. Our track record includes completion of bulk water transmission mains ranging from 200mm to 1200mm diameter in MS, DI and HDPE materials. Our professional site teams are supported by in-house engineers for hydraulic design review, NDT welding inspection, surge analysis, and statutory testing and commissioning protocols.
